title: docs(qa): re-point 18.5.0 checklist batch D (integration-system, automation, i18n)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Frav3V3tzSZWmzEmxegdsb)_

Fixes #33966
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：18.5.0 发版测试里 QA 停放的 31 行条目文字过期，涉及 integration-system、automation、i18n 三个清单文件的 19 个条目，全部按 main 现状改写(另含补丁轮一处:package-flow-override 开关重开后补上那次预算改动)，每个条目 revision +1 并加一行 history。
- 为什么改：跑手照旧文字操作会走错路(错的路由、旧的文件路径、过时的计数、缺必填字段的请求体),把夹具问题误判成产品失败。
- 风险与回滚：只改测试清单文档，不动任何产品代码；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:automation.json 的 setup-packaged-automation-board 与 packaged-flow-clone-contract(两处 clause 措辞改写，不收窄),再看 integration-system.json 的 job-package-key。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Batch D of the #33761 close-out (ledger comment 6896511848, read at `895783a1`). Every row below was re-read at `origin/main` `895783a1` (no `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` commit landed between the ledger read and this branch). Rows repeated across rounds are one edit. All 31 rows are edited; none was already right at this base.

| Ledger row(s) | Item | Clause | Change |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 33, 197 | integration-system.connector-degraded-recovery | acceptance[3].verify | the early retry at kernel-ready MAY appear (timing-dependent); with none the ladder reads 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 s, as both rounds measured; either ladder passes |
| 51, 198 | integration-system.connector-spec-path-no-escape | steps[1] | names which layer answers: the compile-time bundler (`bundle-connector-spec-files.ts`) refuses first in its own wording; the runtime loader texts the clauses quote appear only when the loaded artifact still carries a path string |
| 52 | i18n.build-gates-hold | steps[3] | the symlink farm needs real directories along each `packages/**/scripts` path: `findExtractConfigs` (`scripts/i18n-bundle-surface.mjs`) descends only where the Dirent `isDirectory()` |
| 73, 206 | automation.flow-node-type-matrix | steps[6] | the webhook body must carry `project` (the flow maps it as optional; `showcase_task` requires it) |
| 74 | automation.package-flow-override | steps[5] (read by acceptance[3]/[4]) | decide the override run's pending request before the next budget change, or later runs read failed `DUPLICATE_REQUEST`; a fresh project per change also works |
| 75 | automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract | acceptance[1] clause | dropped keys judged on the clone response and stored definition; a later GET decorates `_packageId` naming the copy's own holder (read decoration, not a carried key). Wording only, not narrowed |

| 78 | automation.setup-packaged-automation-board | acceptance[0].verify | names the entry's `visible: current_user.can('sys_metadata_activation', 'read')` gate (`setup-nav.contributions.ts`) |
| 79 | automation.trigger-type-matrix | fixtures.requires[1] | the fast clone's package must reach `showcase_task`: `com.example.showcase.custom` takes it; a fresh scratch package is refused 422 outside its dependency closure |
| 80 | i18n.studio-follows-app-locale | fixtures.requires[0], steps[2] | `designer.object.*` strings now live in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` |

| 83 | i18n.studio-follows-app-locale | steps[1] | the object surface opens on 记录; the editor form is the 设置 tab |
| 84 | i18n.surface-matrix | acceptance[2].verify | baseline 414 → 317 |
| 85 | i18n.surface-matrix | fixtures.knownGaps[3] | the revoke confirm is now driven live; drops "not yet driven live" |
| 86 | i18n.surface-matrix | steps[18] (feed verb) | the task record page draws no timeline; read the inbox popover's 活动动态 tab or `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` |
| 87 | i18n.notification-localized-and-clears | steps[1] | the switcher stores the platform tag `zh-Hans`, not `zh-CN`; both resolve to the zh bundle |
| 88 | i18n.flow-copy-translation-and-host-override | acceptance[2].verify | toast keys are `flows.FLOW.successMessage` / `.errorMessage` (`FLOW_TERMINAL_MESSAGE_KEYS`), extracted only from a flow that authors them |
| 112, 207 | integration-system.flow-connector-picker | acceptance[1].verify + evidence | the declarative mark is read from the datalist option labels in the DOM after the field screenshot, as acceptance[0] rev 5 did |
| 113 | integration-system.flow-connector-picker | steps[1] | an env-wide scratch flow opens at `/_console/studio/~org/automations?surface=flow:NAME` |
| 115, 210 | integration-system.push-device-registry-and-relay-boot | fixtures.knownGaps[2] | CLOSED: the scratch boots were booted by QA runs #33853 and #33914 and every quoted line printed |
| 118 | integration-system.webhook-lifecycle | negative[1] | the drift guard is reachable only from a planted legacy row (the data door refuses an unknown trigger value) |
| 119 | integration-system.webhook-lifecycle | steps[6] | hold the 409 probe's row non-terminal with a 503 receiver |
| 120 | integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui | steps[5] | the twin import lands as `showcase_custom_orders` in the pair; cleanup names `?package=` |
| 121 | integration-system.job-package-key | steps[1] | the restart's info line depends on load order (`app-artifact-handlers.ts`, the branches after `jobKeyFor`); both lines named |
| 190 | integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix | fixtures.requires[0] | a scratch project for the `os build` door must declare `sharingModel`, or `security-owd-unset` stops it first |

Each edited item: `revision` +1 and one `history` row. The area files are not canonical `JSON.stringify`, so they were edited as text spans: a script replaced each edited string value as its encoded span, asserted each old value occurred exactly once in its item, and asserted the parsed new document equals the old document plus exactly the declared edits (every other item value-equal). The history rows' `ref` is this PR (placeholder swapped in a second commit).

## Tests

Docs only; no test changed or added.

## Acceptance notes

- `automation.package-flow-override` (found while doing #33966, not a ledger row; edited here at the seat's patch round, revision 5 to 6): steps[6] switched the ledger back on and stopped, while acceptance[3].verify reads "with it on the next change runs the override", so the re-arm half had no step. Reading at `895783a1`: the engine's trigger dispatch returns early only while `isFlowEnabled` answers false (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`), so switching the ledger back on arms the next change and does not replay the change made while off; QA record #33853 made that change as its R4. The verify matched the source, so the step moved: steps[6] now PATCHes the budget once more after switching on and decides that run's pending request before step 8. steps[5]'s cross-reference also now cites step 5 (the approval step), not step 4.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts`: the inbound-webhook flow's comment says a body may leave `project` out, while `showcase_task` requires it. Code comment, outside this card's file surface; noted only.
- Runtime facts in the table are quoted from the QA readings (records #33829, #33853, #33909, #33910, #33914); source facts were re-read at `895783a1`.

## Verification

Same 16-family list on 26b0822a, ac75f156 and 1d1460cc, each run with every command exit 0 and `--ran` reconciling 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED: check-adr-links (+ --self-test), check-closing-keyword-parity (+ --self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, plan-test-core-shards --self-test, @objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions, check:ci-filter-parity, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:doc-authoring, check:driver-memory-census, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:platform-checklist (16 areas, 429 items), check:refd-timer-probe, check:watch-hint-literal. `check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0.

</details>
